copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到 Flutter 布局溢出或状态更新错误
copy.tagline_en: Fix Flutter layout overflow and setState errors quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often encounter Flutter layout or state errors

howto.what: 当你在Flutter项目中遇到布局溢出、无边界约束、RenderBox未布局、构建中调用setState等常见运行时错误时，Claude会识别错误并提供修复代码示例。
howto.when: 当你遇到RenderFlex溢出、无边界约束、RenderBox未布局等Flutter布局或运行时错误时触发。

say.text: 我遇到了RenderFlex溢出错误，怎么修复？
ListView在Column里报无边界高度错误，怎么办？

howto.what_en: When you encounter common Flutter layout and runtime errors (e.g., RenderFlex overflow, unbounded constraints, RenderBox not laid out, setState during build), Claude identifies the error and provides specific code fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you report Flutter errors such as RenderFlex overflow, unbounded constraints, RenderBox not laid out, scroll errors, or setState-during-build errors.
